csv_project_name: AE for Central Utility Plant Replacement
csv_scope_of_work: Select an A/E to provide Environmental Assessment administration services as indicated in the DFD Policy and Procedure Manual for Architects/Engineers and Consultants and the DFD AE Contract for Professional Services for the construction of a new Central Utility Plant and demolition of 3 buildings. This project will construct a new heating plant with hot water boilers and water softening equipment. This option would remove all steam, condensate, and domestic hot water piping in the tunnel system. Domestic hot water would be generated inside each building using redundant, double wall, plate and frame heat exchangers. Fuel source redundancy would be realized at the central plant with a new fuel oil tank and pumping system. A new, primary/secondary pumping system would be installed with hot water supply and return lines looped around campus. This will allow any building to be shut down without interrupting service to another building. A portion of piping will be routed through the existing tunnel system and the rest will be direct buried, pre insulated piping.
csv_disciplines_requested: Civil Engineering, Environmental Engineering/Planning/Design, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Structural Engineering, Utility Engineering
